comment: Issue #59 Checkpoint B §10 — approval eligibility parity. The minimum reachable matrix (spec §10): real PostgreSQL repository behavior (packages/database/src/repositories/agent-run-approval-repository.integration.test.ts) and the evaluator approval rule (apps/worker/src/evaluation/approval-parity.test.ts) both consume this same TS-owned fixture. evaluationObservable marks the terminal states the offline evaluator scores (RUNNING is repository-only). The deliberately-unreachable states RUNNING/FAILED with >=1 finalized actions are excluded, per §10.
